Post Date: 2018-04-10T14:11:56Z

Title: extract all visitors and page views
Description: I have a few questions in relation to visitors.
I am trying to find a way to extract some specific info from the logs.

As per your docs goaccess reports unique visitors , 
1. What are the conditions for a visitor to be considered unique ?
2. is there a way to report the total number of visitors to the site regardless if some of them are double up ( non-unique visitors )
3. In relation to page-views as specified in the docs i tried to use
awk '$7~/\.html|\.htm|\.php/' access.log | goaccess -
My issue is the hosted site is WordPress and the pages have no extension;
- home page in the logs file is listed as: '/'
- contact page is listed as: '/contact' etc.

The above log parsing won't work in this case scenario where the pages or posts don't have an extension, is there a way to extract page views in this case scenario ?

Thank You
